summary: This directory is dedicated to the testing of entity differentiation logic. It serves as a verification suite to ensure that data transformation or comparison utilities behave as expected when processing domain entities.
responsibilities: Ensuring data consistency checks perform correctly
relationships: The test suite validates the entity differentiation logic by asserting expected outcomes against various data inputs.
Entity differentiation relies on predefined logic to identify changes between data states.
designDecisions: Co-location of test files with their corresponding domain logic to maintain locality
Isolation of testing logic from production implementation
